title.narrative: OECS participation at the 2025 UN Ocean Conference

description.narrative: The OECS side event at the UN Oceans Conference will directly connect to the Voluntary Ocean Commitments database by announcing renewed and specific OECS commitments. The event will conclude with a call to action, urging the international community to support the OECS's efforts through technical and financial assistance, knowledge sharing, and collaborative partnerships. The aim of the activity is that the OECS Declaration of Commitment will solidify regional unity and leadership on ocean sustainability, and that through showcasing regional successes, it will contribute to position the OECS as a pioneer in innovative marine conservation. Healthy and clean oceans play a central role in removing CO2 from the atmosphere. OECS participated at the UN Ocean Conference to promote their work on blue oceans in the eastern Caribbean.
